children: Roy succeeds Raj Nayak, who has stepped down due to recurring health issues, and will prioritise Yaap’s integration with Gozoop and expansion of its technology offerings
Yaap Digital has appointed Anjan Roy as Chairman, Managing Director and CEO with immediate effect, following Raj Nayak’s resignation as Managing Director due to recurring health issues.

Roy takes over as Chairman, Managing Director & CEO of the Company from the current date. A seasoned professional, he has been a part of the Indian advertising, marketing and media industry for over three decades. He has previously held management and leadership roles in advertising with agencies such as Mudra (currently DDB) and Euro RSCG (currently Havas), and with brands such as HSBC, HDFC Bank, Sony Entertainment Network, Voltas, Coca-Cola and Hero Group, among others.

In 2008, Roy co-founded Brand Planet Consultants. In 2016, Brand Planet Consultants was acquired by Yaap Digital, and Roy has since continued with the company as Senior Partner, leading its branding, design and strategy verticals.
Over the years, Yaap Digital has built expertise across digital strategy, performance marketing, social media and creative solutions, partnering with leading brands across categories.

Commenting on his appointment, Anjan Roy, Chairman, Managing Director & CEO, Yaap Digital said, “Having been part of the Yaap family since Brand Planet joined the Group in 2016, I am honoured to lead the Company into its next chapter. I thank Raj for his leadership and guidance, and we all wish him a speedy recovery and good health.

This is an exciting time for Yaap. Our immediate priority over the coming months is to fully integrate with Gozoop, bringing our teams together to unlock efficiencies in costs and deliveries through common synergies. At the same time, technology is fast becoming a key differentiator for us. Buzzar, our proprietary KoL marketplace, and Tags, our video optimisation platform, are already showing great promise and adoption, and the launch of our AI Studio in the coming months will further strengthen these offerings.
Together, these steps will cement Yaap’s position as a new-age, integrated communication and brand-building partner for our clients.”
